purpose: Teach: 難く/突い/自分勝手/思案/一昔/仕草/相次ぐ/注ぎ

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祖父ちゃんの優しさは忘れ難く心に残るわね
lines.en: Sho, you know — Grandpa's kindness is the sort of thing that stays with you.
lines.style: Warm, reflective tone. Speaks to Sho but really thinking aloud. Soft pacing. A gentle certainty in her voice, like she's sharing something she knows from experience.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お祖父ちゃんの背中を軽く突いて遊んだよ
lines.en: Mom, I poked Grandpa's back to play with him.
lines.style: Quiet, matter-of-fact. Not seeking approval. Simple directness — stating what happened. Small voice, steady. No defensiveness.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、自分勝手な事ばかりしてはダメよ
lines.en: Sho, you can't go around thinking only of yourself like that.
lines.style: Firm but not harsh. A quiet correction — the kind that lands because it's clear and calm. Not lecturing. A mother who expects better because she knows he is better.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんが思案するお顔を見たよ
lines.en: Mom, I saw Dad's face when he was thinking about something.
lines.style: Soft, observant whisper. He's noticed something most people miss. No excitement — just reporting what he saw. Slight wonder underneath, like he's still turning it over.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、一昔前は携帯電話も無かったのよ
lines.en: Sho, you know, a long time ago there weren't even cell phones.
lines.style: Conversational, almost wistful. Speaking across time. Gentle nostalgia without weight. She's not lecturing — just sharing a piece of the world she knows and he doesn't yet.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お祖父ちゃんの仕草を真似したよ
lines.en: Mom, I copied the way Grandpa moves.
lines.style: Small, pleased admission. Pride without showing off. He's observed something and made it his own. The tone of a child sharing a small treasure — expectant but not demanding.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お友達からの招待が相次ぐわね
lines.en: Sho, your friends keep inviting you over, don't they.
lines.style: Warm approval in her voice. Not quite a question — she's noticing something good about him. Light, satisfied. A mother registering that her child is liked and loved by others.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お父さんがお茶を注ぎ足して下さるわ
lines.en: Mom, Dad's pouring more tea for me.
lines.style: Soft, intimate observation. He's noticed a small kindness. The voice of a child winding down — reflective, safe. Trailing slightly at the end, as if he's sitting close and speaking quietly.
